articleHtml:
Red Lobster nutrition is easiest to understand when you know what the published calorie number already includes and what still needs to be added .

Many current entrées include fixed sauces, condiments, or dipping sauces in the published nutrition, but the restaurant lists your chosen side dishes separately. Other meals, such as Create Your Own Ultimate Feast, Seafood Boils, Crab Your Way, and family feasts, are designed from several selectable components.

Use the Red Lobster Nutrition Calculator above to match the exact seafood, preparation, sides, sauces, biscuits, and drinks you actually consume.

Do Not Assume the Entrée Number Is the Entire Dinner

Red Lobster currently states that nutritional content for its entrées includes fixed components such as condiments and dipping sauces, while customer-selected side choices are listed separately .

This distinction matters.

If an entrée is listed at 510 calories and you choose two sides, you should not assume the complete plate is still 510 calories.

A useful Red Lobster calculation usually looks like:

Entrée nutrition

plus:

Side 1

plus:

Side 2

plus any:

extra seafood, additional sauce, biscuits, beverage, appetizer, or dessert

that you consume.

Side Choice Can Change a Meal by Hundreds of Calories

The current side menu spans a very wide calorie range.

Examples currently shown on Red Lobster's ordering system include approximately:

Side

Calories

Roasted Asparagus

90

Coleslaw

110

Side House Salad

160

Seasoned Broccoli

190

Mashed Potatoes

210

Baked Potato

270

Orzo Rice

310

Side Caesar Salad

360

Crispy Brussels Sprouts

380

Hush Puppies

420

Chesapeake Fries

510

Bacon Mac & Cheese

600

Lobster Pasta au Gratin

670

The same seafood entrée can therefore become two very different complete dinners depending on the sides you select.

A 510-Calorie Salmon Can Become a Much Larger Plate

The current Atlantic Salmon entrée is approximately 510 calories before the two customer-selected sides are added . It can currently be prepared grilled, blackened, or roasted.

For example, choosing:

Roasted Asparagus + Seasoned Broccoli

adds about 280 calories.

Choosing:

Bacon Mac & Cheese + Chesapeake Fries

adds about 1,110 calories.

The fish did not change.

The sides did.

This makes side-by-side meal assembly one of the most important features for a Red Lobster calculator.

Potato Toppings Need to Be Added Separately

A baked potato is not always served exactly the same way.

Red Lobster's current ordering system lists additions such as:

Butter: about 100 calories

Sour Cream: about 30 calories

Bacon, Cheddar & Green Onions: about 250 calories

Extra Cheese: about 40 calories.

If you choose a plain or differently topped potato, calculate the toppings that are actually part of the order.

Create Your Own Ultimate Feast Needs a Dedicated Builder

The current Create Your Own Ultimate Feast is one of the clearest examples of why Red Lobster should not use a flat calorie table.

Guests currently choose:

2 Premium selections

plus:

2 Classic selections

and then choose their sides. The current official ordering page gives the meal a broad range of approximately 1,080 to 2,580 calories , depending on the selections.

This should be a real builder inside NutritionSolver.

Premium Ultimate Feast Choices Have Very Different Calories

Current Premium choices include approximately:

7 oz Grilled Sirloin: 320 calories

Crispy Dragon Teriyaki Lobster: 360

Snow Crab Legs: 380

Classic Maine Lobster Tail: 420

Atlantic Salmon: 510

Lobster Pasta au Gratin: 670.

The guest chooses two.

The calculator should therefore use:

Premium 1 + Premium 2

rather than one average Premium value.

Classic Feast Choices Need the Same Treatment

Current Classic selections include approximately:

Garlic Shrimp Scampi: 220 calories

Grilled Shrimp: 250

Walt's Favorite Shrimp: 260

Parrot Isle Jumbo Coconut Shrimp: 470

Shrimp Linguini Alfredo: 620.

Choosing two orders of Shrimp Linguini Alfredo is nutritionally very different from choosing two lower-calorie shrimp preparations.

That is why the total feast range is so wide.

Ultimate Feast Is a Fixed Recipe, Not the Custom Feast

The current standard Ultimate Feast contains:

Maine lobster tail

Snow crab

Walt's Favorite Shrimp

Garlic Shrimp Scampi

and is served with two selected sides.

The current headline nutrition is approximately 1,280 calories before the separately selected side choices are counted .

Do not confuse:

Ultimate Feast

with:

Create Your Own Ultimate Feast .

They are two different ordering models.

Admiral's Feast Already Includes Its Fixed Sauces

The current Admiral's Feast contains:

Walt's Favorite Shrimp

wild-caught flounder

clam strips

bay scallops

with cocktail and tartar sauces.

Its current published entrée value is approximately:

1,670 calories

before the two customer-selected sides.

Because cocktail and tartar sauce are described as part of the standard entrée, do not automatically add them again when using the complete published Admiral's Feast value.

Not Every Seafood Feast Is Fried

The current Grilled Lobster, Shrimp and Salmon combines Maine lobster tail, shrimp and Atlantic salmon finished with brown butter sauce.

Its current headline value is approximately:

1,180 calories

before selected sides.

That should remain a separate complete feast rather than being reconstructed from generic lobster, shrimp and salmon records unless the customer modifies the standard recipe.

Surf & Turf Needs the Steak Cut in the Item Name

Red Lobster currently has distinct Surf & Turf combinations including:

Maine Lobster Tail + 7 oz Sirloin

and:

Maine Lobster Tail + 6 oz Filet Mignon .

NutritionSolver currently lists approximately:

Lobster Tail + 7 oz Sirloin: 740 calories

Lobster Tail + 6 oz Filet: 680 calories

before the customer-selected sides.

The steak cut belongs directly in the item name.

Steak Doneness Does Not Need a Separate Calorie Record

Red Lobster currently allows steak temperatures such as rare, medium rare, medium, medium well, and well.

These should be preparation preferences, not five separate nutrition items unless the recipe itself changes.

The more important variables are:

steak cut

steak size

seafood pairing

sides

and:

toppings or sauces .

Cheddar Bay Biscuits Deserve Their Own Meal Counter

Cheddar Bay Biscuits are one of Red Lobster's most distinctive foods.

NutritionSolver currently lists one biscuit at approximately:

160 calories

3g protein

16g carbohydrates

10g fat

380mg sodium .

Red Lobster currently says entrées come with two warm Cheddar Bay Biscuits , while additional half-dozen and dozen orders can also be purchased.

That makes a simple:

Biscuits eaten: 0 / 1 / 2 / 3 / Custom

control extremely useful.

Extra Biscuit Orders Are Group-Sized

The current official totals are approximately:

Half Dozen: 970 calories

One Dozen: 1,940 calories.

Those totals are for the full package.

Do not assign 970 calories to one biscuit or treat a dozen as one normal serving.

Seafood Boils Need Two Separate Nutrition Layers

The current Seafood Boils are particularly easy to miscalculate.

Red Lobster currently offers:

Sailor's Seafood Boil

Mariner's Seafood Boil

and the new:

Crabfest Boil .

The seafood, corn and potatoes form one layer.

The selected boil flavor can then add a very large second layer.

The 2026 Crabfest Boil Can Vary Dramatically by Flavor

The current Crabfest Boil includes a full pound of crab legs, a dozen shrimp, corn and red potatoes. It is currently offered with Snow or Bairdi crab and several sauce/flavor choices. Red Lobster shows the complete current order in a broad range of approximately:

1,890 to 2,370 calories .

Current flavor selections include:

Cajun

Roasted Garlic

OLD BAY & Butter

Lemon Pepper

RL Signature

and the 2026 limited-time:

Mike's Hot Honey .

This is not a place where one fixed boil number is enough.

Seafood Boil Flavor Can Contribute More Calories Than the Seafood Base

Current Red Lobster ordering data lists flavor components roughly between 1,280 and 1,720 calories for the Crabfest Boil configuration, depending on the flavor selected.

That makes the flavor selection central to the nutrition calculation.

A useful builder should work as:

Choose Boil

→ Choose Crab, if applicable

→ Choose Flavor

→ Choose Spice Level

→ Add Sausage/Egg if selected

rather than presenting only the seafood base calories.

Extra Spice Has Its Own Nutrition

Current Crabfest Boil ordering options also include:

Spicy: about 20 calories

Extra Spicy: about 50

Scorchin': about 110.

If a customer chooses a higher spice preparation, that addition should be included rather than assumed nutritionally identical.

Boil Add-Ons Can Be Substantial

Current boil add-ons include approximately:

Cajun Sausage: 380 calories

2 Eggs: 160 calories.

These need to remain separate from the base boil and selected flavor.

Extra Dunking Sauce Is Not a Small Condiment

Current 4 oz extra dunking sauces are approximately:

OLD BAY & Butter: 590 calories

Cajun: 650

Mike's Hot Honey: 650

Lemon Pepper: 670

RL Signature: 750

Roasted Garlic: 860.

That is very different from a small ketchup packet or squeeze of lemon.

The calculator should show the actual 4 oz serving size prominently.

Crabfest Is Current for Summer 2026

Red Lobster launched the current Crabfest on June 29, 2026 .

The 2026 menu brings back Bairdi crab and adds customizable Crab Your Way preparations, a new Crabfest Boil, Mike's Hot Honey flavor, Crab & Shrimp Linguini Alfredo, and several crab-topped dishes.

These foods should be marked:

Current Limited-Time: Crabfest 2026

rather than permanently mixed into the core menu.

Crab Your Way Needs Crab Type, Weight and Flavor

Current Crab Your Way allows customers to choose Snow or Bairdi crab and select from current flavor preparations.

NutritionSolver should preserve:

Crab type

1/2 lb or 1 lb where applicable

flavor

side

as distinct calculation inputs.

A one-pound crab order cannot share one nutrition record with a half-pound serving.

Crab-Topped Sides Are Different From Normal Sides

Current 2026 Crabfest side upgrades include foods such as:

Crab-Topped Asparagus: about 260 calories

Crab-Topped Mashed Potatoes: about 350

Crab-Topped Baked Potato: about 440.

These are distinct menu items.

Do not apply plain asparagus, mashed potato, or baked potato nutrition when the crab topping is included.

Add-to-Any-Meal Seafood Should Stay Separate

Current add-ons include approximately:

Bacon-Wrapped Sea Scallops: 220 calories

Garlic Shrimp Scampi: 220

Grilled Shrimp: 250

Snow Crab Legs, 1/2 lb: 380

Garlic Linguini Alfredo: 540.

These are useful additions after the main entrée is calculated.

The add-on should not replace the original entrée.

Endless Shrimp Needs Refill Counting, Not One Fixed Meal Number

Red Lobster brought Endless Shrimp back in April 2026, and the current Monday Daily Deal continues to feature Endless Shrimp at participating restaurants.

The current Monday lineup includes selections such as:

Garlic Shrimp Scampi

Shrimp Linguini Alfredo

Walt's Favorite Shrimp

Parrot Isle Coconut Shrimp .

There cannot be one useful calorie value for every Endless Shrimp meal.

Track Each Endless Shrimp Selection You Actually Eat

The right calculator model is:

Starting selection

plus:

Refill 1

plus:

Refill 2

plus:

Refill 3

and so on.

Each shrimp preparation has a different nutrition profile.

A guest eating several Garlic Shrimp Scampi servings has a different meal from someone alternating Coconut Shrimp and Linguini Alfredo.

Walt's Favorite Shrimp Has Its Own Complete Serving

The current standard Walt's Favorite Shrimp dinner is approximately:

520 calories

before its customer-selected side, and the cocktail sauce is part of the standard preparation.

When the shrimp appears as a component of another feast, use the serving published for that specific feast rather than automatically reusing the full standalone dinner portion.

Kids Meals Need the Selected Side

Current kids entrées also allow a side selection.

For example, the current Kids Macaroni & Cheese is approximately:

310 calories

before the selected side is added.

Current Kids Golden-Fried Fish is approximately:

530 calories

before its selected side.

The calculator should therefore work as:

Kids entrée + Kids side + drink if consumed

instead of showing the entrée number as the complete meal.

Family Meals Must Never Be Treated as Individual Servings

Red Lobster currently sells several family meals, including Seafood Boils, Create Your Own Family Feast, Ultimate Family Feast, Admiral's Family Feast and Fish Fry Family Meal.

These are group meals.

They need completely separate serving logic.

Create Your Own Family Feast Serves Four

The current Create Your Own Family Feast:

serves 4

includes:

3 selected favorites

2 family-style sides

and:

8 Cheddar Bay Biscuits .

The current official ordering page gives a broad 1,830 to 4,830 calorie range before further optional extras depending on the configuration.

A useful calculator should let users view:

whole family meal

and:

estimated 1/4 share

while making clear that actual portions may not be divided equally.

Family Sides Are Not Normal Side Portions

Current family side examples include approximately:

Coleslaw, serves 4: 440 calories

Mashed Potatoes: 640

House Salad: 640

Seasoned Broccoli: 760

Baked Potatoes, 4: 1,080

Orzo Rice: 1,240

Caesar Salad: 1,440

Crispy Brussels Sprouts: 1,520

Chesapeake Fries: 2,040

Bacon Mac & Cheese: 2,400.

Do not mix those records with regular individual side servings.

Family Desserts Need Slice-Level Context

Current whole-dessert options can be extremely large.

Examples include:

Key Lime Pie, 8 slices: 4,160 calories

Triple-Chocolate Brownie, 24 pieces: 6,220

Classic Cheesecake, 10 slices: 9,870

Chocolate Wave, 14 slices: 13,020.

Those numbers represent the entire dessert.

The calculator should support:

whole dessert

or:

number of slices/pieces eaten .

Red Lobster Nutrition Questions

How many calories are in a Red Lobster Cheddar Bay Biscuit?+
How many calories are in the Ultimate Feast?+
How many calories are in Admiral's Feast?+
How many calories are in Atlantic Salmon?+
How many calories are in Chesapeake Fries?+
How many calories are in Red Lobster Bacon Mac & Cheese?+
Does Red Lobster entrée nutrition include the sides?+
How does Create Your Own Ultimate Feast nutrition work?+
Is Crabfest available now?+

Build the Red Lobster Dinner in the Correct Order

For a standard entrée:

Choose entrée → Side 1 → Side 2 → Extra seafood → Biscuits → Drink/Dessert

For Create Your Own Ultimate Feast:

Premium 1 → Premium 2 → Classic 1 → Classic 2 → Sides

For a Seafood Boil:

Boil → Crab type → Flavor → Spice level → Add-ons → Extra dunking sauce

For Endless Shrimp:

Count every shrimp selection and refill actually eaten

For family meals:

Build the group order first, then calculate the portion personally eaten

Red Lobster has unusually detailed current nutrition information. The key is not simply collecting more numbers. It is preserving what each number represents so the diner does not confuse an entrée base, a selected side, a boil flavor, a family portion, or a complete meal.
